Hey all! Welcome to Bartoon's Recurve! This is a future world where plastic poisoning has caused the population to become 90% men. After a global war, a pacification and new government establishment, science created a medical breakthrough! They could fix the population imbalance! The plan is to roll-out to the entire world, but first, they need to propogandize everyone. And the gov found their representative in Layton/Laysee!

Hey all! This is a special Valentine's Day Episode. As the main story moves forward, I wanted to give a snapshot into some of the post-gender-change aspect of Laysee's journey.

In this special episode, the Recurve Program realizes people want to see more of Laysee Cummings! So they convince Chad to go on a candlelight concert date for v-day of course!

But how to get Laysee out of the house? Well, lie to her of course! They tell Chad there's no papparazzi! Which is technically true, but they've rigged every corner of the concert with hidden cameras to capture every angle and every breath. so that they can live stream to the millions of men watching! (and hopefully convince more to join the recurve program!)

This is a special Valentine's Day Episode. As the main story moves forward, I wanted to give a snapshot into some of the post-gender-change aspect of Laysee's journey. This is about 26 of 60 pages, the rest you can read on my Patreon. The NSFW ones are there! Enjoy!
